ataśca dahana eva tasya kāraṇaṃ nāśvādaya iti sthitametat
tathā ca dahanasya kāraṇattvaṃ yojitamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ yatho ktaprakārābhyāmevamiṃdhanādisāmagryāḥ sarvasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ yojayitavyaṃ
satsvapi tasmāddahanādanyeṣu samartheṣu taddhetuṣviṃ dhanādiṣvasyābhāve na bhavatīti
nanu caitadeva yuktamvaktuṃ tadabhāvena bhavatī tyatha kimarthaṃ satsvapi tadanyeṣu samartheṣu taddhetuṣvityucyata iti cedāha
yasmādevaṃ satsvapītyādinā'bhidhīyamāno'sya dhūmasya tatkārya tvamagnikāryattvaṃ samarthitaṃ niścitamasandigdhambhavati

kevalaṃ tadabhāvena bhavatītyupadarśyate tadā tadabhāvena bhavatītyupa darśane kriyamāṇenyasyāpi tu gavāśvāderindhanādeśca tatrāgniśūnyabhūbhāge'bhāve sati sandigdhamasyāgneḥ sāmarthyambhavatīti kutaḥ kāraṇabhāvaniścaya iti samudāyā rthaḥ
satsu hi samartheṣu taddhetuṣu 2a3 kāryānutpattiḥ kāraṇāntaravikalpaṃ sūcayatī ti sandigdhamasyānyathā sāmarthyamityetadevānya ttatretyā 2a4 dinā sūcayati
asya svabhāvāttanna jātamiti kutoyaṃ niścaya ityarthaḥ
yadyanyattatra samarthantada bhāvāttanna jātametannivṛttau nivṛttistarhyasya kathamiti cedāha
yadā tu satsvapīti kriyate tadā sarvveṣāṃ tatra sannipātādetasyaiva nivṛttāvasya nivṛttiriti niścayānna yadṛcchāsamvāda ityabhiprāyaḥ
māturvivāha ucita ācarito yasmindeśe sa tathā
janma utpattiryasya tasya pārasīka deśabhāvi na yāvat
deśāntare mālavakā dideśe yathā'bhāvo mātṛvivā hābhāve yadṛcchāsamvādastadvadatrāpi
tathāhi mṛdviśeṣābhāvāddeśāntare tasyābhāvo na tu mātṛvivāhābhāvāditi kākatālīyastadabhāve tasyābhā va iti
anye ṣu gavāśvādiṣu samartheṣu taddhetuṣvasyāgnyādikāraṇakalāpasyābhāve na bhavati
yadi punaste tasya hetavaḥ syu stadā tatkalāpasannidheḥ prāgapi paścādiva dhūmotpādaprasaṅgaḥ
bhavatu tarhyubhayorapi na naḥ kācit kṣatiriti cet
yathā'pagateṣvapi sarvveṣu teṣu tasmiṃ kalāpe sati bhavatyeva tasya sambhava iti tada bhāve na bhavatīti vācyaṃ
anyathā tasya kalāpasyābhāve na bhavatītyupadarśane tasyāpi gavāśvādestatrābhāve sati sandigdhamasya kalāpasya sāmarthyambhavet
yato'nyad gavāśvādi tatra śaktaṃ tadabhāvāttanna bhūtametasya kalāpasya nivṛttau nivṛttiryadṛcchāsamvādaḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvvayat
evaṃ yathoktena vidhinā taddhūmādi tasya vahnyādeḥ kāryaṃ samarthitaṃ niścitaṃ sidhyati bhavati
athavā evaṃ pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ sama rthitasattattasya kāryaṃ sidhyati
yadi nāma sidhyati ta t kibhityāha
siddhaṃ sat svasambhavena ātmasannidhānena tatsambhavaṃ tasya kāraṇasya sannidhānaṃ sādhayati 2a6
kāryakāraṇabhāvaniścayāstiddhaṃ tadutpattilakṣaṇa prativastu yatraivamatādṛśa upalabhyate tatraiva svasattāmātreṇa deśakālādyapekṣayā tat svakāraṇaṅgamayatīti
anyathā hi tattasya kāryameva na syāt
nahi yadvyatirekenayad bhavati tattasya kāryaṃ yuktaṃ
anyasya tvaṅkurādeḥ svakāraṇaireva bījādibhiravyabhicāra iti kuta etadityāha
yadā dhūmasya svakāraṇāvyabhicārasta- dutpatteḥ siddhastadā bījādibhirātmīyaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sahāṅkurādīnāṃ sarvvakāryāṇāṃ sadṛśo'vyabhicāranyāyaḥ
tathāhi tepi yathoktaprakārābhyāṃ pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ tatkāryatayā siddhāḥ santastadavyabhicāriṇaḥ siddhyanti
evamiti pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ yathoktaprakārābhyāṅkāryahetāvapi na kevalaṃ pūrvvoktena prakāre ṇa svabhāvahetāvasamarthanamvādinaḥ parājayasthānamityapi śabdaḥ
asamarthite tasminkāryakāraṇabhāve liṅgaliṅginorliṅgasya vā tatkāryattve ārabdhārthāsiddheriti kriyāpadaṃ
arthāntarasyāpi tadbhāve pratibaddhasvabhāvasya bhāve bhavatyeva tadbhāvaniyama ityata āha
prayogaḥ punaryo'rthāntarabhūto yasminna pratibaddhasvabhāva stasya bhāve na tadbhāvaniyamaḥ
tat ca paramārthataste na kāryaheturevopāttasttadyadi nāma tatkāryantena na samarthitaṃ tathāhi kathamasau nigṛhīta ityāha
vastutaḥ kāryasyāpyupādānapratipādanādi 2a8 ti tatkāryatvasyeti vi śeṣaḥ
nodyate tasya tatraivet yapitvanya tra tajjātīyasya
yadi copalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāḥ piśācādayopi bhavanti tajjātīyānāṃ anyeṣāmprabhāvavatā vā
ya evāsau pratipādyastasyaiva yadupalabdhilakṣaṇañcā yāti tasyaivānupalabdhisādhanaṃ nānyasyeti
asadvyavahārasiddheriti vacanamasadvyavahāra eva tayā sādhyate na tvabhāvaḥ svabhāvānu palabdheḥ svayamabhāvarūpatvāditi pradarśanārthaṃ
yadyayaṃ trividhena viprakarṣeṇa vyavadhānena deśakālasvabhāvalakṣaṇena na viprakṛṣṭaṃ merurāmasurādirūpavat svabhāvavi śeṣa ucyate
sa cāsau pratibhāsaśca tasya viveko'bhāvastenākāreṇa yatpratipa ttuḥ pratyakṣantatrāpratibhāsituṃ śīlaṃ yasya rūpasya svabhāvasya tadrūpantathoktaṃ
yaḥ sajātīyavijātīyarahitenātmanā pratibhāsate svajñāne tadanyakāraṇasamavadhāne sati sa svabhāva iti yāvat
tādṛśa iti trividha viprakarṣāviprakṛṣṭarūpaḥ padārthastathā'nātmarūpapratibhāsavivekena pratipattṛpratyakṣapratibhāsenāśayenānupalabdhaḥ sa na asadvyavahārasya viṣayo bhavati
vidyamānopīndriyasyālokasya manaskā rasya vā'bhāvānnopalabhyate tādṛśastatkathamasadvyavahāraviṣayo bhavatīti cedāha
nahi hetvantarasannidhānamiti svaphalotpādanānuguṇaḥ pariṇāmo bhavati kāraṇasya
tathāhi satyāmapi pṛthivībījajalādisāmagryāmatibahunaiva kālena tālabījasya svakāryodayānukūlā pariṇatirbhavati
kiñcānyatprabhāvavatāyoge pi śācamāyākārādinā'dhiṣṭhito bhavati yadāyaṃ bhāvastadā vidyamānopi nopalabhyate tatkathamuktaṃ tādṛśaḥ satsvanyeṣūpalambhakāraṇeṣvanupalabdho'sadvyavahāraviṣa ya iti
tathāhi atroktaṃ svabhāvo yaḥ satsvanyeṣūpalambhakāraṇeṣu sanpratyakṣa eva bhavatī ti
yaścāyaṃ santānapariṇāmama pekṣate yaśca prabhāvavatādhiṣṭhitaḥ sa svabhāvaviśeṣa eva na bhavati
naivantarhi sarvathā' bhāvaḥ sādhito bhavatīti cet suṣṭvanukūlamācarasi
tasya ca tatsākalye'nupa lambhesya ca vyavahāraviṣayatā sādhyate na tu piśācādisvabhāvāviśiṣṭarūpasyeti

etenaiva yadekenāvaśyaṃ sāmagrisākalyepi pariṇāmastālagaṇabījavadityādinā sa tamatiśayavat matimato manāgapyanava gacchantaścodyacuñcavaścocudustatra sarvaṃmayaṃ duḥsthitaṃ veditavyamityalamapratiṣṭhitabālapralāpairiti viramyate
yataścaitadevaṃ tatastasmātkāraṇādanyathā sati liṅge samavāya upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhi muktvā yadanyadasadvya vahārasādhanamanupalabdhimātraṃ liṅgamupādīyate
tadā tasminsati saṃśayo bhavati nāstyasadvyavahāraniścayaḥ upalabdhinivṛttāvapyarthābhāvāsiddheriti samudāyārtha ḥ
yadi vā tato dṛśyānupalambhālliṅgāt sakāśādanyathā sati liṅge saṃśaya iti vyākhyātavyaṃ
athavā tata upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptāda nyathā tadvihīne saṃśaye sati talliṅga iti vyākhyeyaṃ
anyenāpi sāmānye vi śeṣyevayavidravyasaṃyogavibhāgādinā tathāvidhena tathā bhavitavyamiti kuto'yaṃ niyama ityata āha
tasyā sato lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yathoktānupalabdhirlakṣaṇaśabdaśca karaṇasādhanastasyāviśiṣṭatvāt sāmānyaviśeṣāvayavidravyādāviti vākyaśeṣaḥ
yadyevaṃ sāmānyaviśe ṣatā tasyāstīti kasmāttathā sadvyavahāraviṣayatvannābhyupagamyate
anyatra śaśaśṛṅgābhāve daṇḍena puruṣasya yogaḥ sa eva ityarthaḥ

anupala bhyamānaṃ tvīdṛśamityupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptannāsti tasmādetāvatsātra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhimātrannimittaṃ yasyāsadvyavahārasya sa tathā khyātaḥ tadanenāsat vyavahārasyānanyanimittatāmāha
nanu ca yasya yatra na kiñcitsāmarthyamasti tadasadvyavahāraviṣayo yathā nabhastale kamalaṃ
tathābhimatepi deśādāvabhimatasya bhāvasya na kiñcitsāmarthyamastīti sarvvasāmarthyaviveka eva nāstitvavyavahārasya nimittaṃ bhaviṣyati
a nyasya tannimittasyābhāvāditi kadācit kaścit brūyāditi tanmatamāśaṃkate

evaṃ manyate sūktametat sarvvasāmarthyaviveko nimittamiti kintu sa eva sarvvasāmarthyavivekoyaṃ padārthaḥ kathamavagato yathoktāmanupalabdhimapāsya yena sarvvasāmarthyavi veko'syāsadvyavahārasya nimittambhaviṣyati
yadā tu yathoktānupalabdhyā tasya sarvvasāmarthyavivekinaḥ pratītirbhavati
punarapi paronyasya tannimittasyābhāvādityasya kadāci dayuktatāmbrūyādityāśaṅkate buddhivyapadeśa 2b3 ityādinā
tathā hi tāḥ pravarttamānā vastusattāṃ sādhayanti
tāśca nivarttamānāḥ svanimittaṃ sadvyavahāraṃ nivartayantyagniriva dhūmaṃ
tataśca buddhyādinivṛttau cāsadvyavahāranimittamiti nedaṃ yuktaṃ vaktumanyasyetyādi
yathoktapratibhāṣābuddhiḥ pratipattṛpratyakṣapra tibhāsirūpanirbhāsā yathoktaḥ pratibhāso yasyā iti vigrahaḥ
nahi vastusatva upalaṃ bhapratyayāntarasākalye ca sā nivarttata iti niveditametat puro'smā- bhiritibhāvaḥ
tavanena yadyevaṃvidhā buddhirabhimatā tvayā tadāvayoraikamatyameva tathāpi na naḥ kiñcidaniṣṭamuktaṃ syāta
tasyāḥ sakāsātsadvyavahāraḥ syātparo kṣe'rthena kevalamanantaroditarūpāyāḥ svagrāhya ityapināha
yadi nāmevaṃ tataḥ kathamvyabhicāra iti cedāha
tadviparya iti tasyā yathoktaliṅgajāyā buddhervinivṛttāvanaikāntikaḥ sandigdha ityarthaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ viprakṛṣṭerthe deśādiviprakarṣaiḥ pratipattṛpratyakṣasya pramāṇasya nivṛttāvapi saṃśayātkāraṇāt
idañca prahī ṇasakalajñeyāvaraṇasya pratyakṣanivṛttau tvasaṃdeha eveti kathanāyopāttaṃ
ayamasyābhiprāyo yadi nāma pramāṇatrayannivṛttamapratyakṣavastuni tathāpi tannāstīti kutoyanniścayaḥ
na ca te na santīti śakyamabhidhātuṃ
nanu cātra liṅgajāyā materasadvyavahārahetuttvaṃ niṣeddhumārabdhantadviparyyaya ityādyabhidhānāt
tatkasmādaprastutasyaiva pratyakṣasya cāgama sya copakṣepaḥ kṛta iticet
nanvidamuktaṃ sadvyavahārāsadvyavahārayoranyonyavyavaccheda sthitalakṣaṇatve naikābhāvasyāparabhāvanāntarīyakatvāt viprakṛṣṭe tannimittā bhāvāt sadvyavahāranivṛttyā'sadvyavahāra iti

tathāhi parokṣe'rthe sadvyavahāranivṛttiḥ kathantannimittābhāvepi dvayorapyanayoranupalabdhyoḥ svaviparyayahetvabhāvabhāvābhyāṃ sadvyavahārapratiṣedhaphalatvantulyamekatra saṃśayādaparatra viparyayāditi vacanāt saṃśayeneti cet
yatra tu niścayena sadvyavahāranivṛttistatrāsadvyavahāropi pukta evānyaḥ pravartanaphalosītyukteḥ na cābhāvarūpavyavacchede bhāvānuṣaṅgosti niyamena
nahi bandhyātanayanabhaḥpaṅkajādiṣvasadavasthatā bhavati pratiṣedhāt sadavasthatā bhavati pratiṣedhamātrantu syāt
adhunā sāmānyabhūtānāṃ buddhivyapadeśānāṃ sadvyavahārahetutvamapi nāstīti kathayannāha
te sarvve buddhivyapade śā na vastusattāṃ sādhayanti
teṣāmvā bhedābhedau na vastubhedābhedayoḥ sattā sadbhāvamiti
śaṅkhacakravartī 2b7 tyādinā prakāreṇa tadanena vastusattāṃ sādhayantītyetasya kāraṇamāha
nānaikarūpāṇāmbuddhivyapadeśānāṃ tadanena na vastubhedābhedau sādhayantīti sādhayati
śaṅkha cakravartītyādyanutpannavṛtteḥ śabdairviṣāṇamityādi yadopāttasya rūpaṃ sanidarśanañcakṣurvijñānajanakatvāt
atha kathamidaṅgamyate sanidarśanādibuddhiśabdā na vastubhedaṃ sādhayantītyataḥ prāha
kasmādevātra vastuni rūpādāvupasaṃhārātsanidarśanaṃ sapratighaṃ rūpamityeva samānādhikaraṇatvāditi yāvat
anekaṃ sambandhinaṃ sanidarśanatvādikamupakṛtyānupakāre tena teṣāntatra sambandhitvāyogādityabhi prāyaḥ
anekaṃ sanidarśanādi śabdaṃ 2b9 tebhyaḥ sambandhibhyaḥśakāsādātmani saṃmārgayannidamāyāsapatane kāraṇaṃ
yadi punarevaṃ bhavettadāko guṇo labhyata ityāha
evaṃ hayanena paramparānusāraśramaḥ parihṛ to bhavatī 2b9 ti
śaktibhedaiḥ sambandhinamupakaroti tebhyaśca śabdāḥ pravartanta ityayamparamparānusaraṇāyāso'nenatapaśvinārūpādinā tyakto bhavatītyarthaḥ

nanu ca pratiniyatopi kāryaśaktimantaḥ sarvva eva bhāvāstvayāpyetadavasyamevābhyupeyamanyathā kasmācchālibījaṃsālyaṅkuramevotpādayati na yavāṅkuramiti pareṇābhiyuktena kimabhidhānīyaṃ bhāvaprakṛtiṃ muktvā
tathāhi śakyametatmayāpyabhidhātumanekasambandhyupakāra eva tasya sāmarthyaṃ nānaikaśabdotthāpanamiti cet
upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānāñcānupalambhāt na copalabdhilakṣa ṇaprāptaṃ sadanupalabhyamānamastīti śakyate vaktumatiprasaṅgāt
anupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatāyāṃ vā kathaṃ tannibandhanāḥ pratyayavyapadeśāḥ pravarttante gogavayādiṣu
etenopalabdhā- nāmapi kṣaṇikatvādivat vyaktivyatirikteṇānupalakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yasmātsāmānyaṃ yadi dṛṣṭamapyavikalaṃ bhinnaṃ na saṃlakṣate
bhāve tadbalabhāvinī bhavati sā yā śabdavṛttiḥ kathaṃ
daṇḍyādau na nibandhanasya na gatau dhīśabdayorasti sā tasmādasya kathañcideva tadapi te yuktyā na saṅgacchate
bhedānna hetuḥ karmāsya na jātiḥ karmasaṃśrayā || 7
na ca puruṣābhiprāyānapekṣo vyaktyupakṛtasapratighatvā disāmānyasāmarthyabhāvenopaneyo vivakṣāyāntu saṃmukhībhāvepi pravṛttiprāptaḥ
puruṣābhiprāyānurūpe vā sa evāstu niyāmakaḥ kimantargaṃtṛbhiḥ sāmānyaiḥ
tathāhi tadgatānvayavyatirekānuvidhāna meva lakṣyate sāmānyānāṃ na nityānāmavyatirekatvāt
kalpanā ca saiva kartavyā yā punarnna paryanuyogamarhati tatratyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ varameva kalpanādoṣābhāvāt
nahi ekasya nānā suka śabdotthāpane sāmarthyamastīti
anupakāre hi teṣāṃ 2b10 sanidarśana tvādīnāntenāṅgī kriyamāṇe tatsambandhitā na sidhyati
nahi yo yena nopakriyate heduḥ sa tasya samvandhiyukto himavā niva malayagireriti bhāvaḥ
ta eva jaḍimnaḥ padamudvahantaḥ punarapi paryanuyuñjate
tathāhi vicāraviṣayāpannaḥ paṭastantubhyo vyatiricyate bhinnakartṛkatvāt ghaṭādivat
nahi tantavaḥ tantusamudāya iti vā paṭe pratyayo duṣṭaḥ
ataśca the last two lb's of folio 20 are missing in the book pūrvvottara kālabhāvittvād bījāṅkurādivat
iha yadyasya vyavacchedakantattasmādanyattadyathā gopiṇḍāccaitra ityetāni tadvyatirekasādhanapramāṇāni santi
ghaṭa ityapi ca rūpādaya evaikārthakriyākāriṇa ekaśabdavācyā bhavantu kimarthāntarakalpanaye 2b10 ti kāryamityupaskriyate
yāni tvetāni tatpratipādanāya pramāṇānyuktāni tānyasiddhatādidoṣaduṣṭatvānnālaṃ tadbhedasādhanāyeti bho tā nāmeva purataḥ chāyāndadhatīti manyate
tathāhi nedaṃ tāvadādyaṃ pramāṇaṃ parīkṣyamāṇaṃ pūrvvāmapi parīkṣāṃ kṣamate
a nyāvasthāvasthitebhyo vā tantubhyaḥ paṭasyānyatvaṃ sādhyate viśiṣṭasaṃsthānāvasthitebhyo veti
tatra na tāvadayamādyaḥ prakāraḥ sahate vicārabhāragau ravaṃ
tataśca tebhyonyattvamiṣṭameveti siddhasādhyatāprasaṅgopanipātapiśācaḥ kathamiva bhavantaṃ na gṛhaṇāti
dvitīyopi vika lpaḥ tīvrānalopatapta ivopalatale talāni pādānāṃ na pratiṣṭhāṃ samāsādapati
nahi viśiṣṭasthānāvasthitebhyaḥ paṭasya bhinnakartṛkatvaṃ paraṃ prati siddhapaddhatimavatarati yohi tādṛkprakārebhyonyatvamabhāvādeva nābhyupaiti sa kathamiva bhinnakartṛkatvamabhyupagamiṣyatīti
yataḥ paṭa iti tantuṣveva sanniveśaviśeṣeṇāvasthiteṣu pratyayo vartate
yattvidamupāyāntarasādhyatvād bhinnadeśāvasthitaiḥ kriyamāṇatvāt bhinnaparimā ṇatvātpūrvottarakālabhāvittvād bhinnaśaktimatvācceti
yasmādindīvarasya gandhādayaitīndivarasvabhāvā gandhādayo madhubhāvanāviśeṣādikāryanivarttanasa marthā iti yāvat
aviśiṣṭakāryasādhanātmanā sāmānyabhūtagandhādiśabdaiḥ prasiddhāviśiṣṭakāryasādhanākhyena viśeṣeṇa ye viśiṣṭāsta evamucyante
na punaratrānyat kiñcidityarthāvarṇitalakṣaṇaṃ dravyamasti tasya tādṛśo'nupalabdherityuktaprāyaṃ
teṣāntadvyacchedakaṃ ca na cātyantaṃ bhinnamiti ko'nayorvirodha iti
rūpasya svabhāva ityatrāpi śilāputrakarūpayoḥ śarīrasvabhāvavyavacchedakatvamastīti bhedastayorapi tataḥ prasajate na ca bhavati
kiñcedamativikalairmithyādarśanasaṃrāgapiśācāviṣṭabuddhibhiḥ kimindīvarasya gandhādaya ityete śa bdāḥ puruṣābhiprāyavyāpāranirapekṣā eva vastutatvanibandhanāḥ pravarttante
kimvā yathaiva taiḥ prayujyante tathaiva vastutatvamanapekṣya tamarthamasatkāreṇa pratipādayantīti
ya dyādyaḥ pakṣastadā sadādhvananaprasaṅgo'tītādiṣvanyatra ca puruṣe cchāvasānniyojanannabhavet
tadā na puruṣecchābalapravṛttaśabdavasādarthatatvaṃ vyavatiṣṭhata iti tada vasthaṃ sandigdhavipakṣavyatirekatvaṃ hetoriti
etenaitadapi pratyuktaṃ vipratipattiviṣayāpannāccandanādanye rūparasagandhasparśā heyatvādayaścati pratijānīmahe na vyapadiśyamāṇatvāt
yathā bahavo bhasmādhā rana lālāthūkādayastathā ca yathopadiṣṭadharmavantastantvādaya iti svabhāvahetuḥ
parasparavyāvarttamānānāmapi yadyekasvabhāvānabhyupagame tasya teṣu sarvvātmanā'nyathā vā vṛttyayogo bādhakampramāṇaṃ
kutastaddhi yugapadanekatra sarvvātmanā varttamānamanekādhārasthitādheyava danekattvamātmano'numāpayatīti kathamasyābhinnasvabhāvatā yojyate
tepi hi tasyāvayavā iti pāṇyavayavavṛtteṣvapi anyena varttitavyamityādinā tadanyaikadeśābhāvavānekaḥ kaścidavayavī vidyate
tathā cā ṇvādisamudāya evāstu konurodhaḥ svātmabhūteṣvavayaveṣviti
na vā kvacidapyasau vṛtto na hyekadeśāḥ pratyekamavayavītyalaṃ pratiṣṭhitamithyāpralāpairiti viramya te
yathā rūpālokamanaskāracakṣurāda yaścakṣurādivijñānamekaṃrva kuvnti tathā rūpādayopyudakadhāraṇaviśeṣādikāme- kāmarthakriyāṅkariṣyantītyarthaḥ
yataścaitadevaṃ tasmāttasyaikārthakriyāsāmarthyasya khyāpanāya tatra rūpādāvekasya paṭādiśabdasya niyogopi syāditi etadyuktaṃ paśyāmaḥ
evaṃ manyate kenacitprayojanena kecicchabdāḥ kvacinniveśyante tatra yadanekamekatropayujyate tadavaśyantatra codanīyaṃ
na cāsyānanyasādhāra ṇaṃ rūpaṃ śakyaṃ codayituṃ
nāpyasyāyāsasya kiñcitsāphalyaṃ kevalamanena yogyāstatra terthāścodanīyāsta ekena vā śabdena codyeran bahubhirveti svātantryamatra vaktuḥ
yadi hi na prayoktu ricchā kathamiyamekatrāpi vartteta
icchāyāmvā ka enāṃ bahuṣvapi pratibaddhuṃ samarthaḥ
bhinneṣva pyekasmācchabdātpratītiratatprayojanabhedena yathā syādityuktatvāt prayojanasya tasmātsūktamasmābhiryuktaṃ paśyāma iti
yathā kathañcidvinaiva prayojanena lokaḥ śabdaṃ prayuṃkte
na ca niḥprayojanā lokasyārtheṣu śabdayojane 3a1 ti
na hi vyasanamevaitallokasya yadayamasaṅgataṃ yanna prayujjāno vā śabdāntaḥ khalvā sīt
kintarhi sarvva evāsyārambhaḥ prayojanasāpekṣaḥ prayojanañcetadukta miti manyate tatra prayojanavatveneti
yathā rūpagandharasādayaḥ sahaikaprayojanāḥ saṅkali tā ekakāryakāriṇa ityarthaḥ
samavahitānāmapi kadācitkasyacideva kārye vyāpāronyasya tvaudāsīnyamiti syādāśaṅkāsaṃbhavastata āha
tatraitasmin śabdaira rtha pratyāyanakrame yerthā rūpādayaḥ saha pṛthagvaikaprayojanāsteṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ saṃhitānāṃ pṛthubudhnodarākārasaṃsthāpitānāmekaṃ prayojanaṃ
yaduta madhūdakādyāharaṇaṃ pṛthagvā teṣāmeva pratyekaṃ svākārajñānajananaṃ
ekañca tatprayojanamekatra dṛṣṭaṃ yattadanyatra nāstīti sahabhūtānāmapi kadācidaudāsīnyadarśanātsarveṣāṃ savyāpā ratāmādarśayituṃ pṛthagvetyabhihitaṃ
kevalamatraikaprayojanā ityabhidhānā tsarveṣāntathābhāvapratītirastyeveti vyarthampṛ thagveti syāt na cāyaṃ śabdārtha iti yaktiñcidetat
taiḥ prakaraṇaṃ na lakṣitaṃ tathā hyatra samudāyaśabdasyaikavacanapravṛtyavirodhaḥ kathayitumārabdhaḥ
yattvidamuktaṃ kevalamatraikaprayojanā ityabhidhānātsarvve ṣāṃ tathābhāvapratītirastyeveti tadapi na yuktisaṅgataṃ
tathāhi parabalaparājayodyatānāmekaprayojanavatvepi na tatra sarvve vyāpāravanto bhavanti
ata eva ca syādāśaṅkāsambhava iti vyākhyātaṃ
yadā tu sarvveṣāmeva savyāpāratākhyāpanāya pṛthagvetyetaducyate tadā'pahnu ratamutsāryate
astu vaitadapi vyākhyānaṃ yadi kathañcidvyavasthāpituṃ pāryate
teṣā mevaṃ vidhānāmarthānāntasyaikārthakriyākāriṇo bhāvasya khyāpanā yaikoghaṭādiśabdo yadi niyujyeta tadā kiṃ syānna kaściddoṣaḥ syāt
guṇa eva tu kevalo labhyata ityāha
tadarthakriyāsa kte rabhinnāyāḥ khyāpanāya niyuktasya samudāyaśa bdasyaikavacanavirodhopi nāstyeva 3a2
yasmātsa hitānāṃ sā śaktirekā 3a3 'bhinnā na pratyekaṃ na tu pṛthagbhūtānāmityarthaḥ
iti tasmātsamudāyaśabde tasminnaikasminghaṭādau samudāye vācye ekavacanaṃ ghaṭa iti bhavatīti śeṣaḥ
satyaṃ samudāyāntaravṛtyapekṣayā jātiśabdoyaṃ rūpādisamudāyyapekṣayā tu samudāyaśabdopītyabhisandheradoṣaḥ
kecittu samudāyaśabdā eva yathā vindhyahimavatsumervādi śabdāḥ
arthānāṃ ghaṭāvīnāṃ pratyekaṃ sahitānāñca śakteḥ kāraṇāt nānāśaktirekā ca
etaduktaṃ bhavati yasmādeko pi vṛkṣo gṛhakaraṇādyarthakriyānivarttanepi yogyo baha vopi vṛkṣāḥ
tataśca teṣāṅkevalānāmapi yogyatvādanekā śaktiḥ samavahitānāmapi yogyatvādekā śaktirekapratyavamarśapratyayanibandhanatvenaikatvopacārāt
yataścaiva miti tasmādyathākramaṃ nānāśaktivivakṣāyāṃ satyāṃ bahuvacanamanekatvācchaktervṛkṣā iti bhavati
22 iti tadāpi na kaściddoṣa iti darśayati
ko hi nāma sacetanaḥ puruṣābhiprāyamātrādhīnavṛttiṣu śabdeṣvabhiniveśaṃ karttumu tsahata iti bhāvaḥ
nāneko rūpādirekaśabdotthāpane samartha iti ce 3a5 diti
puruṣāṇāmvṛttiricchā tatrānapekṣāḥ santo'rthāḥ kiṃ svayaṃ śabdānutthāpayanti
āhosvitpuruṣaiste vyavahārārthamartheṣu yathā kathañcinniyujyanta iti vikalpadva yaṃ
tatra puruṣaireva te yatheṣṭaṃ niyujyante'nyathā'tītā jātayordarśanāntarabhediṣvanyatra vā niyojananna bha vediti bhāvaḥ
tataśca svayaṃ 3a6 puruṣecchā'napekṣāṇāmarthānāṃ śabdotthāpane sati bhāvasya śaktirasakti rvā cintyeta nāmaika ityādinā

tasmātpuruṣaisteṣāṃ śabdānāṃ niyogortheṣu vināpyekatvādinā te puruṣāḥ yatheṣṭamekatrāpi vahuvacanāntama nekatrāpyekavacanāntaṃ śabdaṃ niyuñjīranniti kastatra teṣu śabdeṣūpālambho nāneko rūpādirekaśabdotthāpane samartha ityayaṃ naiva kaścit kevalamatibahulavyāmohavijṛmbhitamiti manyate
nimitañca niyogasyoktameveti 3a6 tatsāmarthyakhyāpanāya tatraika śabdaniyogo'pi syādityatrāvasare
ka thaṃ sambandho naivānekasya ekena saha sambandho virodhābhyupagamāt
na ce 3a7 dayamekena sa ha sambandhavirodhāt kāraṇā dekaśabdaṃ rūpādiṣu necchāmaḥ

te rūpādaya e kasvabhāvāḥ santaḥ samudāyāntare kamvalādau yeyamasambhāvinī udaka dhāraṇa viśeṣādyarthakriyā tāmeva kuryustena kāraṇena tasyā arthakriyāyāḥ prakāśanā yemāmete'rthakriyāṃ na te tadasambhāvinīmarthakriyāṅkurvanti
yathā ta eva kambalaga tā rūpādayaḥ sajātīyebhyaḥ
tathā ca ghaṭagatā api rūpādayaḥ kambalagatebhyo rūpādibhyo'viśiṣṭasvabhāvā iti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ
kiṃñcāniṣṭañceda 3a10 masmābhirghaṭakambalādiṣvabhinnā rūpādaya iti kuto rūpādīnāmpratisamudāyattve hetubalādanapekṣitadravyāṇāṃ svabhedābhyupagamāt
yadyanya eva rūpādibhyo ghaṭaḥ syāt kiṃ syāditi
tasyāvaya vinaḥ pratyakṣasya sataḥ 3a10 cakṣuḥ sparśanendriyagrāhyatayābhyupagatattvāt
tadvivekena rūpādivivekena buddhau cakṣuḥ sparśanendriyajāyāṃ pratibhāsane kimāvaraṇanna kaścitpratibandha ityarthaḥ
na ca kaścidatyādareṇāpratihatakaraṇopi ni rūpayannīlamadhurasurabhikarkkaśādivyatirekeṇa tadrūpamviviktarūpaṃ ghaṭādidravyamupalabdhumīśa iti manyate
rūpādyagrahepi dravyagra haṇamastyeva yato mandamandaprakāśe'nupalabhyamānarūpādikaṃ dravyamupalabhyate'niścitarūpaṃ gauraśvo veti
tathāyaskañcukāntargate puruṣe puruṣarūpādyagrahe pi puruṣapratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ
rātrau ca valākāvyāmukta rūpādyagrahepi pakṣipratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ
tathā kaṣāyarūpeṇa paṭarūpābhibhave paṭarūpādyagrahe'pi paṭapratyayo dṛṣṭa iti
tathāhi yattāvadidamuktaṃ mandamandāloke rātrau ca nīlādyupadhāna sadbhāve ca tadrūpādyagrahepi dravyamupalabhyata iti tatra vaktavyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatra dravyamupalabhyata iti
nanu śyāmarūpaṃ mandamandāloke rātrau ca tatra tadapulabhyate upadhānaṃ rūpañca
na cāpyaṇyākāreṇa bodhena vastuno'vagatiḥ yasya kasya- cijjñānasya sarvvavastuparicchedakattvaprasaṅgāt
tasmād bhrāntametat jñānambhrāntivījātsvopādānādanādi kālīnānnirviṣayameva tathā pratibhāsi dvicandrādipratyayavadupajāyate
na cārthāvisamvāda nādevāsya saviṣayatvaṃ yuktamanu mānena vyabhicārāt
tadeva dravyantathā gṛhaṇāti tatonyasya nirviṣayattvamiti cet
nanu na tad dravyanta drūpanna vānyākārānusyūtaḥ pratyayo'nyasya paricchedaka ityuktaṃ
tathā hi samāpyetacchakyamvaktuṃ ta eva nīlādayastathā pratibhāsanta iti
asati bhrāṃtisandehakāraṇe sālokāvasthāyāṃ yogyadeśāvasthāne ca nirupadhānāvasthāyāñca nopalabhyate

tat dravyamanātmarūpapratibhāsi vivekenānyadā tu sati bhrāntisandehakāraṇe niśāndhakārāvacchāditalocanāvasthāyāṃ dūradeśāvasthāne sopadhānāvasthāyāñca tada nyākāravivekena pratibhāsata iti konyo bhautikādvaktumarhati

tathā hi puruṣaśa rīrāvayavasamāśrayabalodbhūtaviśiṣṭasaṃsthānāvasthitakañcukadarśanātkāryaliṃgajñānāt sambandhasmaraṇāpekṣiṇaḥ kāraṇabhūte tathāvidhe puṃsi puruṣoyamityanantara meva pratyayaḥ samudbhūtimāsādayati
ata eva cāspaṣṭākārā sā pratītiḥ kaścāyamiti saṃśayaśca bhavati
tathāvidhasaṃsthānasya ca kañcukasyottpatteḥ puruṣarūpādaya e va hetavo bhavanti natvanyadavayavi dravyaṃ
tadevaṃ dravyasya pratyakṣatvāsiddheryaduktaṅgavāśvamahiṣavarāhamātaṅgā vimatyadhikaraṇabhāvāpannā rūpādivyatiriktā ityeva ghoṣaṇā
yad dṛśyaṃ satsadvyatirekeṇa nopalabhyate tattato bhinnannābhyupeyannāstīti vābhyupagantavyaṃ
yathā naraśirasi viṣāṇannopalabhyate ca dṛśyaṃ sannīlādiṣu tadvyatirekeṇa sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃyogavibhāgaparatvāparatvādikamiti svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ
na ca tasmādavyatirikta evāyaṃ tatra cāyandoṣa ityāgūryāha
prayogopunaryo yasyātmabhūtaḥ sa tannivṛ ttāvekāntena nivarttate pravṛttau cāsanneva pravarttate yathā tasyaivātiśayasyātmā
na vā sāvatiśayo'nanvayaḥ pravarttate niva rttate vā'taḥ purvasmin pramāṇe sādhyavikalatvandṛṣṭāntasya
sānvayatve cātiśayasya nivṛttipravṛtyoraṃ gīkriyamāṇe kā kasya nivṛttiḥ pravṛttirveti 4b4
tathā ca sarvaṃ sarvatra samupayu jyetetyādinā puronukrānto doṣonupayujyata ityabhiprāyaḥ
yadi ca kasyacit svabhāvasyātiśayākhyasya pravṛttirnivṛttirveti svayamabhyanujñā yate tvayā
nānumanyate bhadramukheṇabhavedevaṃ yadi yathāmayā pravṛttinivṛttī abhyanujñāyete tathā tenāpi
pratibhāsamānāśca vivekene 3b1 daṃ nīlamidaṃ surabhi madhuraṃ karkaśamida miti ceti pratyakṣā arthā dṛśyante'pṛthagdeśatvepi sati ke te rūpādayaḥ
ta thā 'bhinnendriya grāhayatvepi vātātapasparśādaya 3ba iti yathākramaṃ caitaduttaraṃ
upetya ca dharmisambandhaṃ abhinnendriyagrāhyatvasya vyabhi cāra ukto natvasāvasyāstyekadeśāsiddheḥ
ālokanīlādīnāṃ tvabheda eva yataḥ pradīpādisannidhānāt prakāśarūpā eva tathāvidhasvabhāvādhyāsitavapuṣaste samudbhavanti na tu teṣāṃ bhedo'stīti sādhanavikalpatā'pi dṛ ṣṭāntasyeti manyate
tasmādasya pratyakṣatvamabhyupagacchadbhirna bahiravaśyaṃ rūpādivivekena prati bhāsanamabhyupagantavyamanyathā pratyakṣatvāsiddheḥ
sa svarūpañca notkarṣeṇa darśayatyapratibhāsamānatvāpratyakṣatāñca svīkarttumicchati dārśanaṃ spārśanañca dravyamiti siddhānte pāṭhāt
mūlyadānakrayā vidyantesyeti mūlyadānakrayī na tatheti vṛttiḥ
athavā kretuṃ śīlaṃ yasyāsau krayī mūlyadānena kra yī na tathā
nanu caiko ghaṭa iti pratyayavyapadeśasadbhāvādrūpādivat tadastyeva
tatkathamasyāsatvamiti cedāha buddhiśabdādayopi vyākhyā tā na ca sarvva ityādinā
na ca pratyakṣasyārthasya rūpānupa lakṣaṇaṃ 3b3 yuktaṃ
tadbhāvasādha nañca liṅgamabhyupagamyeta tadbhāṣyate na tu tadgamakaṃ liṅgaṃ kiñcidapyasti
yasya sadbhāvasādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāsti na tadastī tyaṅgīkartta vyaṃ
yathānabhastale kamalaṃ nāsti cāvayavino'stitvasādhakaṃ pramāṇamiti sadvyavahārapratiṣedhaphalāmanupalabdhiṃ manyate
evaṃ vistareṇaikadravyābhāvaṃ pra tipādya prakṛtamupa saṃharati
ata eva na teṣāmbuddhyādīnāmviparyayātteṣāṃ sattādīnāmvi paryayo'bhāvaḥ
yohi yasya bhāvameva na sādhayati sa kathamiva varttamānastadabhāvaṃ sādhayatītyākūtaṃ
yadi nāma buddhyādayaḥ sattāmbhedābhedau vā na sādhayantyarthakri yā tu tānsādhayiṣyatītyata āha
arthaṃkriyātastu sattāvyavahāraḥ syādi 3b4 ti tallakṣaṇatvāt sattvasyeti bhāvaḥ
satyametadekaṃ tu bahavīṣu sāmagrīṣu varttata ityanekārthakṛdityucyate
yathā pradīpasya vijñānasya varttivikārasya jvālāntarasya ca svaparasantānasambandhikṣaṇāntarasyo tpādanāni tadevaṃ sattābhedavyavahārābhāve kāraṇaṃ
ekasyaiva īdṛśasyānekakāryajananātturyātiśayakroḍī kṛtaṃ rūpavataḥ svahetubhyaḥ saṃjātattvāditi bhāvo nyāyatattvavidaḥ
yārthakriyā 3b6 madhvādyā haraṇādilakṣaṇā tasminghaṭādāvadṛṣṭā satī punardṛśyate
yathā paṭe'dṛṣṭā satyudakadhāraṇādyarthakriyā ghaṭe dṛśyamānā 3b7 sattābhedaṃ sādhayatīti prakṛtenābhisambandhaḥ
adṛṣṭā ca tantuṣu prāvaraṇadya rtha kriyā paṭe dṛśyata iti 3b7 pakṣadharmopadarśanamiti
arthāntarantathāpyavayavī na sidhyatīti 3b7 kuta etadyato yathāpratyayamasyāṃ saṃskārasaṃtatau svabhāvabhedotpatteḥ kāraṇādarthakriyābhedaḥ prāvaraṇādilakṣaṇo bhavati
etaduktaṃ bhavati piṇḍīkṛtebhyastantubhya upādānakāraṇabhūtebhyaḥ kuvindādisahakāripratyayasannidhānācca viśiṣṭasanniveśāvacchinnā eva tantavo jāyaṃ te
na tu viśiṣṭasaṃsthānāvacchinnebhya iti tyajyatāmiyamarthāntarā vayavisiddhipratyāśeti
tadetenaivā viddhakarṇṇo ktaṃ pūrvvottarakālabhāvitvādityādi tatsādhanamapahastitaṃ veditavyaṃ
nanu ca tantavaḥ paṭa iti buddhivyapadeśabhedāt
tatraivaṃ sthite yaduktaṃ prāktvayā'rthakriyātaḥ sadvyavahārasiddhirbhavati viparyayāccārthakriyā nivṛtte viparyayo'sadvyavahāra iti satyametat
sa eva viparyayo'rthakriyāyā anupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpteṣu na sidhyati
tathāhi yadyayamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupa lambho neṣyate tadāsyārthakriyāsāmarthyaṃ nāstīti kathamadhigataṃ bhavatā
syāt ma taṃ sa svabhāvasyaivānupalambho'yaṃ tu punaḥ sāmarthyasyetyata āha
tathā ca tasya sāmarthyasya yonupalambhaḥ sa svabhāvasyaiva iti tasmāt pūrvakaiva svabhāvā nupalabdhireveyaṃ sāmarthyānupalabdhiḥ
yasmāccaivantasmādanena vādinā kvacicchaśaviṣāṇādāvasadvyava vahāramabhyupagacchatā dṛśyānupalambhādabhyupagantavyo- 'nyasya tatpratipattyupāyasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
tataḥ sonupalambho'nyatrāpi sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃyogāvaya vidravyādau tathāvidhe upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpte aviśeṣa iti sopi sāmānyaviśeṣādistathāstvasadvyavahāraviṣayattvenāstītyarthaḥ
syādetannaiva sāmānyaviśe ṣādistathāvidhonupalabdhosya sadvyavahāraviṣaya ityata āha
ayamatrārtho dvyoranupalambhe tannimitte tulyepi yadyasadvyavahāraḥ sāmānyādau notpadyate
anyatrāpi tarhi sa nābhyupeyo viśeṣahetvabhāvādi tyanena ca pūrvvoktameva kasya cidasatobhyupagame tallakṣaṇāviśeṣāditi smārayati
tasmā tsarvva evaṃvidho dṛśyānupalambho'sadvyavahārasya vi ṣaya 4a2 iti vyāptiḥ

asatopi kāryasya kāraṇādutpāde yo yajjananasvabhāvastata eva tasya janma janma nānyasmāditi niyama 6a3 iti
idaṃ atrā rthatatvamavidyamānamapi tailaṃ tilebhya evotpadyate
śaktipratiniyama eva ca kathami ti ca paryanuyoge vastusvabhāvairuttaraṃ vācyaṃ
ya evambhavanti yathā vā tathaiva pradhānā nmahān eva jāyate nāhaṅkāro mahato 'haṅkāro na pañcatanmātrāṇītyā di prakriyā
tena yaduktannahyasatve kaścid viśeṣa iti tadayuktimat
tasmāt puronukrāntayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ sandigdhavi pakṣavyāvṛttikatvasādhanakalaṅkāṅkito heturiti

na vidyate ādirasyeti vigrahaḥ anāditvābhyupagamāddhetuphalaprakṛti paraṃ parāyā nānavasthādoṣo laghīyasīmapi kṣatimāvahatyanyathā'dau kalpyamāne tasyāhetukatvaprasaṅgastenāsthāna eveyamāśaṅkā bhavata iti bhāvaḥ

yo yajjananasvabhāvastata eva tasyātiśayotpattiriti śaktiniyamasamāśrayāditi kadācitsvasiddhāntamanādṛtyāpi parobhidadhātyāśaṅkāyāṃ na mamāpyetacchaktipratiniyamāvalamvanaṅkenaciddaṇḍena nivāritamityāgūryāha
prayogopunaryasya yajjananāya samarthaṃ kāraṇamasti sosannapi jāyata eva yathātiśayaviśeṣaḥ
tathā yo yatrāvidyamānatajjananasamarthakāraṇaḥ sa tatrāsatvepi nodeti
yathā tileṣu ghṛtātiśayastathā cāvidyamānatajjananasamarthakāraṇaḥ kāryaviśeṣaḥ kāraṇaviśeṣa iti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ
śakyasya śa kyakaraṇāt kāraṇabhāvācca satkā ryaṃ || 14
sarvvaṃ hi sādhanaṃ vivādapade vastuni saṃśayaviparyāsāvapanayantadviṣayanniścayapratyayamutpādayadvibhartti nāmānurūpaṃ na dvayamapyetat kāpilamate sambhavati
yasya kasyacidatisaya syā 6a1 bhivyaktilakṣaṇasya tatra sādhye niścayarūpe kathañcidasata utpattau prāptātsādhanāt so'tiśayastatrāsan kathañjāyate
samastasādhyaniścayābhivyaktilakṣaṇaḥ sarvvasmādanyasādhanāt sādhanābhāsāt votpadyeteti tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ
natviyamavikṛtarūpeṣu kṛtāspadā sā hi tatsvarūpalakṣaṇā tadviṣayajñānalakṣa ṇā
rūpāntaraprādurbhāvalakṣaṇābhāvā bhavetsvarūpaṃ tāvat avikāryamiti na sādhanairanyairvā kartuṃ śakyate
vikāre vā pūrvvasvabhāvavāniva pūrvvarūpaprādurbhāvaścetyasatkārya vāda eva samarthitaḥ pūrvāpararūpatyāgāvāptilakṣaṇatvāt vikārasya
caitanyasyaikatvādaparastadviṣayaḥ pratyayo na bhavati parasyeti tadrūpābhi vyaktiranupapannā
rūpāntaraprādurbhāve ca nānyasya kiṃcidapyupajāyate vilakṣaṇatvāditi tṛtīyāpi vyaktirasambhavinī dvitīyāyāmapyayamanivārito doṣaḥ
sādhanāpekṣādeva sādhyaniścayāt svaviṣayajñānotpādenaivāpekṣātiśa yotpattilakṣaṇāsthireṣu labdhāspadeti pratipāditaṃ sarvvadā vā bhavet
grīvādisannive śaviśeṣāvacchinna eṣorthakriyāviśeṣakārī kaścit mṛdvikāro ghaṭa ityucyate nānyaḥ
sa cet prāgapi mṛptiṇḍāvasthāyāmapi tadāvyaktāvasthāyāmiva tadarthakriyopalbdhau syā tāṃ
na ca bhavatastasmānnāstyevāsāviti niścayaḥ samādhī yatāṃ kimalīkanirbandheneti
yasmānna ca rūpapratibhāsabhedepi vastubhedo yukta ḥ, atiprasaṅgāt
yadi bhinnapratibhāsi jñānaṃ bhedaṃ sādhayati tadā sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ asaṅkīrṇā bhedavyavasthā bhavet
nānyathā tathā ca mṛptiṇḍaghaṭayorapi parasparamatyaṃtambheda iti pratijānīmahe
nahi tasya ghaṭādestasminnupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpte svabhāve sthitau satyāmanupalabdhiryujyate
athāpi bhavati tadā'sthitiśca tasminsvabhāve'tatvamata tsvabhāvatvamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptātsvabhāvādekāntena bheda iti yāvat
dharmayoryathā śiṃśapā- tvavṛkṣatvayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvaṃ kenacitpramāṇena prasādhya vyāpakasya vṛkṣatvādernnivṛttiprasādhanaṃ samarthanaṃ sādhanāṅgasyetyadhyāhāraḥ
nanu tatra svabhāvānupalabdhyaiva tadabhāvaḥ sidhyati taktimanayā
nahi niṣpāditakriye karmaṇāṃ viśeṣādhāyi sādhu sādhanambhavati
sarvvathā yatraiva vyāpyā bhāvo na niścīyate kvacit kutaścid bhrāntinimittāt tatraiveyaṃ prayujyate
kāraṇānupalabdhirapi yatra kāryābhāvo na niścīyate tatraiva prayoktavyā nā nyatra vaiyarthyāt
anayā diśā svabhāvaviruddhakāryopalabdhyādiṣvapi sādhanāṅgasamarthanaṃ sujñānameveti noktaṃ
neha dhūmāddhimasparśo na śakyaṃ śītakāraṇa 16 miti
natu dhavasthityāthavā khadiramityādāviva pūrvvārthaparityāgena vikalpādivi dhasyāpyarthasya vivakṣitatvāt
trirūpahetuvacana samudāyagrahaṇena teṣu lakṣaṇādivacanānāṃ sādhanatvaṃ tirayati
vaidharmyavati ca na sapakṣasatvamanantara meva niṣedhyamānatvāt

paramārthatovasthitastasya vacane ye prakāśake pakṣadharmavacanaṃ sapakṣasatvavacane pakṣadharmavacanaṃ vipakṣasatvavacane vā tayossamudāyaḥ tasya va canadvayasamudāyasyāṅgampakṣadharmādivacanamiti pakṣadharmavadanantāvadavicalamitarayoḥ tvanyatarānyatarat kādācitkaṃ
na kevalaṃ dvayoḥ prathamavyākhyānusāreṇetyapi śa bdāt
sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa vā tasyāḥ siddheranutpatteḥ tathāhyartha e va pratibandhārthaṅgamayati
nābhidhānamarthapratibandhavikalatvāt tasmāt pratijñāvacanaṃ hetuvacanaṃ vā na sākṣātsādhanamarthasiddhau
saṃśayaśca pakṣavacanādaryeṃ dṛṣṭo na niścayastadatopi na sākṣāt sādhanaṃ
evaṃ sati kṛtakatvādivacanepyavyutpaṃ nānāṃ saṃśayo bhavatītyanekāntaḥ
vādiprativādino rhi niścitatvamekasmin vā dharme'nityatvādike pratyāyayitumārabdhe bhavet pratyanīkadharmadvaye vā
yadāhyekasminvastuni pramā ṇabalena viruddhau dharmau vādiprativādibhyāṃ niścitau bhavatastadā tadvastu dvyātmakaṃ prāptaṃ
atha na pramāṇasāmarthyāt tau niścitāvapi tu svasmātsvasmādāga māt
evamapi tu dharmayoḥ pramāṇena niścayāt kathanna pakṣavacanāt saṃśayo bhavatīti vācyaṃ
hetuvacanantu śakyasūcakatvāt śaktitaḥ sādhananiṣṭaṃ sadocyate sādhanāṅgampratijñāva canatve sati sādhanopakārakatvāddhetuvacanavat
jñā nātmamanaḥsannikarṣādīnāmapi sādhanopakārakatvamato vacanatve satīti viśeṣaṇaṃ
yasmādanityaṃ śabdaṃ sādhayetyabhyarthaṃnā vāhyaṃ vacanatve sati sādhanopakārakaṃ sādhyasādhakaviparyayaprakāśakañca na ca tadantaraṅgaṃ sādhyasiddhā vāṅgaṃ
ko vā viṣayopadarśanasyopayogo yadi hyanena vinā na sādhyasiddhiḥ syāt
yaḥ kaścitkṛtakaḥ sa sarvo'nityo yathā kumbhādiḥ śabdaśca kṛtaka ityanuktepi pakṣaśabdo'nitya ityarthāṅgamātra eva
syādayaṃ viparyāso yadi hetuvyāpāraviṣayopadarśanāya pakṣavad vacanannaiva prayujyate tadā kathampakṣasamāśrayalabdhavyapadeśā

na khalu sādhanakāle pakṣadharmatvādivikalpo'sti ke valaṃ yatraiva jijñāsitaviśeṣe dharmiṇi śabdādau tu ca karīśādisthagitatejasi vā kuṇḍādau yo dharmaḥ kṛtakatvadhūmatvādilakṣaṇonumānataḥ pratyakṣato vā pratīyate
tadviśeṣayogitayā vā niścite'parasminghaṭamahānasādāvasthitatvena smaryate tadviśeṣavirahiṇi vā gaganasāgarādau nāstitvenai va smaryate
sa vastudharmatayaiva vināpi pakṣadharmatvādivyapadeśena tat dharmiṇaṃ jijñāsitadharmaviśiṣṭaṃ sāmarthyādeva pratipādayati
sa cāsya sāmarthyaviṣayaḥ pakṣa iti gīyate
tataḥ paścāt tatsamāśrayabhāvinyo yatheṣṭapakṣadharmatvādisaṃjñāḥ śāstreṣu saṃvyavahārārthampratanyante
yadi vā pratyālocanaprakaraṇabalāt sādhanakā lepi bhavantu pakṣadharmatvādivikalpāḥ
kathaṃ yohi vastuno dharmo vādinā vivādāspadībhūtadharmiviśiṣṭatayā sādhayitumiṣṭaḥ sa pakṣastasya yonyo dharmaḥ sa pakṣadharmaḥ
yasyāpi hi sādhanakāle pakṣaprayogosti tasyāpi na vādyakāṇḍameva pakṣaṃ jāte'ni tyaḥ śabda iti
kastu prastāvāntarenāpi prakaraṇabalenaiva pakṣadharmatvādayopi vaktavyā ḥ
tatratāvadu dāharaṇāpekṣastathetyupasaṃhāro na tatheti vā sādhanasyopanayaḥ nyā0 sū0 1
evañcāyaṅkṛtaka iti sā dhyena saha sambhava upanayārthaḥ
tathā ca hetuvacanād bhinnārthapratipāda katvamupanayasyābhinnarūpatve prasiddhaparyāyavyatiriktatve ca sati hetuvacanottarakālamupādīyamānatvāt dṛṣṭāntavacanavaditi śakyeta anumātuṃ
pratijñāvākyād bhinna rūpatve sati hetuvacanottarakālamabhidhīyamānatvāt dṛṣṭāntavacanavat
yoya māgacchatyayaṃ viṣāṇīti kenacidukte tasmādanaśva ityādivacanavat
tadetat pratiṣidhyate na khalvevaṃ prayogaḥ kriyate
yo vā kṛtakaḥ sa sarvvo'nityo yathā ghaṭādiḥ
tathā ca kṛtakaḥ śabda i tyevamubhayathā yatheṣṭaṃ prayogaḥ kriyate
tatra yadi kṛtakaḥ śabdo yaścaivaṃ sa sarvvo'nityo yathā ghaṭādirityabhidhāya tathā kṛta kaḥ śabda iti pratibiṃbanārtha mupanayavacanamucyate
tadyathā daśadāḍimādi vākyaṃ tathā cānarthakaṃ pratibiṃbanārthamupanayavacanamiti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdheḥ
svārthānumitāvapyayameva nyāyo dṛṣṭo nahi kaścitsacetanaḥ kṛtakattvasya bhāvaṃ śabde gṛhī tvā tasya cāvinābhāvitvamanusmṛtya tathā ca kṛtakaḥ śabda iti pratibimbanārthakaroti
athāpi yaḥ kṛtakaḥ sa sarvvo'nityo yathā ghaṭaḥ
tathā ca kṛtakaḥ śabda i ti sambhavapradarśanārthamupanayavacanamucyate
pratijñānantarabhāvinastu sādhanamātranirdeśamanityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvādityeva na pratipadyāmahe

yat punaridaṃ siddhārthanirdeśalakṣaṇaṃ nigamanaṃ paunaruktyaparihārāya varṇyate tannaivopapadyate vinā nigamanenārthasiddhereva pañcāvayavasādhanavādino'nupapatteḥ anyathā nigamanāt prāgevārthasya siddhatvāt vyarthatayā na sādhanāṅgannigamanamprāpnoti
bhavedvyāmoho vipra tipannasya pramāṇāntaravyapekṣā nāstīti siddhamanityatvamucyate
nigamanaṃ tu prativiṣayasyārthasyāśeṣapramāṇopapattāvaśeṣāvayavaparāmarśenāvadhāraṇārthama nitya eveti pravarttata iti
yadi tarhi pramāṇāntaravyapekṣā nāsti tattarhi sādhyaṃ sāmarthyādavadhāryata eva
yathā kuṇḍādiśabdaśca kṛtaka ityevamanityatvāvinābhāvinaḥ kṛtakatvasya śabde bhāvakhyātau tatsāmarthyādevānityaḥ śabda iti niścayo bhavati
tadasya vacanaṃ sāmarthyaṃ pratītārthapratyāyakatvāt punaruktamanu pādānārhañca
yatsāmarthyāt pratīyate na tasya vacanamprekṣāvatā karttavyaṃ
tadvacanampunaruktamvā tadyathā gehe nāsti kumāro jīvati cetyetatsāmarthyāt pratīyaṃmānasya tadvahi rbhāvasya vacanaṃ
pakṣadharmānvayavyatirekatadvacanasāmarthyācca pratīyate tasmādanitya evetyevamādinā punaḥ sisādhayiṣitorthaḥ prathamasādhyāpekṣayā vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhirdvitīyasādhyāpekṣayā ca svabhāvahetuḥ
sādhanāvayavaḥ pratijñāṃ prāpnoti niyamena sādhyapratītini mittatvāt pakṣadharmādivacanavat
tata evasaṃsayotpatteḥ pakṣadharmavacananna sādhanaṃ sādhāraṇādivacanavaditi cedāha
nanu ca pakṣadharmasya śrāvaṇatvāderapradarśite sambandhenaiva sādhanāvayavatvamato vipakṣatvābhāvānna vyabhi cāraḥ
pradarśite tu sambandhe sādhanāvayavatvaṃ tadā ca tasmāt saṃśayo nāstīti sutarānnānekānta iti
pakṣavacanepi tulyame 6b6 taditi tadapi sā dhanaṃ syāt
atha pratipadyethā satyaṃ syādyadi sādhyaṃ syānna cāstyanyataḥ sādhyasiddhaḥ
na ca niṣpāditakriye dāruṇi dātrādayaḥ kañcanārthaṃ puṣyanti
apradarśite tu saṃba ndhe saṃśayotpattihetutvādidamuktantata evasaṃsayotpatteriti
yadyevaṃ na tarhi tatprayogamantareṇa sādhyasiddherabhāva iti vyartha eva tatprayogaḥ syāt anyathā kaḥ pakṣavacanaṃ sādhanādapākarttuṃ samarthaḥ
tataśca trirūpaliṅgā khyānaṃ parārtha manumānamityādyācāryavaco vyāhanyeta
pakṣa ucyate ākṣipyate prakāśyate aneneti pakṣavacanantrirūpaṃ liṅgaṃ
ākṣepo hyabhidhānatulya iti vacanamityuktaṃ vacera nekārthatvādvā
prayogasya tu sambandhe bahu syādasamaṃ jasaṃ || 20
yasyārthasya prastutasya sa sādha nāṅgastasyaivābhivyaktiruttareṇa padadvayena
yathā buddhīndriyadehakalāpavyatirekātmāsti nāstītyetāvat mātre vubhustite naiyāyikāḥ pramāṇayanti

sadādyaviśeṣavi ṣayā viṣayajñeyaviṣayā madīyāḥ pratyakṣādayaḥ pratyayā madīyaśarīrādivyatiriktasamvedakasamvedyāḥ svakāraṇāyattajanmavatvādibhyaḥ puruṣāntara pratyayavaditi tataḥ sadanityandravyavat kāryakāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavaditi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣa iti mahatā vyāsena sadādyaviśeṣād vyācakṣate
nahyatra sa dādyaviśeṣaviṣayā viṣayajñeyaviṣayatvandharmaviśeṣaṇaṃ kathaṃcidapi prakṛtasādhyasidhyupakāri
paravyāmohanānubhāṣaṇaśaktivighātādihetorityatrādiśa bdenottarapratipattiśaktivighātahetoḥ parigrahaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ prasaṅgo yasyeti vigrahaḥ
yatra nāma vihitapratisiddhovā didoṣaguṇasaugatadharmavinayasyāpyahaṅkāranimittasakaloddha vādimalakṣālanāyodyatamatraiva nātmavādinastatsādhane nṛtyagītādeḥ prasaṅgaḥ
nanu ca vayaṃ bauddhā brūma iti kathaṃ yāvatā saviśeṣaṇasya pratiṣedhābhidhānāt
yathāhaṃgārgobravīmyahaṃ paṭu bravīmi iti na ca bahu ṣvevetadvahuvacanamiti pāṇiniḥ 2
naiva yasmādasāvātmani parān svayūthyānapyanyānbahūnapekṣya tathā prayuktavān
īdṛśyāmeva ca vādino vivakṣā yāmidamuktamudāharaṇaṃ nānyasyāmiti pratipattavyaṃ
athavā jaḍaśābdikābhiniveśanivāraṇāyedamevamuktaṃ tathā ca vyarthatā śabdānusāsanasya pratipādayi ṣyati
dvādaśānāmpramāṇādilakṣaṇānāṃ yaḥ prapañco vistarastasya prakāśanāya yacchāstraṃ mīmāṃsākhyaṃ tasya praṇetā sa cāsau jaiminiśca tena pra tijñātaṃ yattatvaṃ nityatābhidhānaṃ
tasyādhikaraṇaṃ yaḥ śabdaḥ sa ca ghaṭaśca tayoranyatarastena sa dvitīyo ghaṭa itītthaṃ pratijñāmuparacayya dvādaśalakṣaṇādivyākhyānaṅkaro ti
2 ścodaneti kriyāyāḥ pravartakamvacanamāhuś codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyava hi taṃ viprakṛṣṭa...
sa tarhi tādṛśo dharmaḥ pṛthagvācyo netyāha
evaṃvidhasyāpi prastutasādhyadharmanāntarīyakasya prativādinā'jijñāsitasya tadvyatirekeṇa pratijñāyāmanyatra cāhetudṛṣṭāntayoḥ kadā punaretadasādhanā ṅgavacanaṃ yathoktaṃ nigrahasthānamityāha
yadā tu na pratipādayati tadā dvayorekasyāpi na jayaparājayau bhavataḥ kutaḥ sādhanānabhidhānānna vādino jayaḥ
yatra viṣaye jijñāsite ajijñāsite punardoṣasyānudbhāvanepi nāparādha ityabhiprāyaḥ
syānmatiḥ sapakṣa vipakṣayoḥ sadasattvayoryaugapadyenāprayoge kathañca prakārāt nyūnatocyate
yadā sarvvopasaṃhāreṇa vyāptivyatirekābhyāntadākṣepopi nāsti tadeyaṃ vyavasthāpyate
bhavatvayamaparosyāparādho na hyekadoṣālīḍhānyeva sādhanāni bhavanti trayo hetvābhāsā dṛṣṭāntā bhāsāścāṣṭādaśa nyāyavindau tṛtīye paricchede sodāharaṇāḥ prapañcena draṣṭavyāḥ
nanu ca yukto nirdoṣe sādhane prativādino doṣānudbhāvanānnigrahaḥ
sadoṣe tvajñānāsāmarthyābhyāmanudbhāvanepi doṣasya duṣṭasādhanaprayo gādvādina eva parājayo yukto na prativādina iti
yadyevaṃ duṣṭenāpi sādhanena vādinā prativādinastiraskṛtatvāt kasmājja yo na bhavati tasyetyāha
durjanānāmvipratipattiraśobhano vya vahāraḥ tasmānna yogavihito nyāyyaḥ kaścidvijagīṣuvādo nāma yacchalādibhiḥ kriyata ityadhyāhāraḥ
ukte sati nyāye tatvārthī cet prativādī pra tipadyeta tamarthaṃ nyāyopetaṃ
atha svapakṣarāgasya valīyastvāduktepi nyāye na pratipadyeta
tadā tena prativādinā tasya nyāyasyārthasyāpratipattāvanya samīpavarttyātmajño janakāyo na vipratipadyeteti kṛtvā nyāyānusaraṇameva satāṃ vāda iti varttate
yathoktaṃ tatvādhyavasāya saṃrakṣaṇārthañjalpavitaṇḍe bījaprarohasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ kaṇṭakaśākhāvaraṇavaditi nyā0 sū0 4
tasya doṣatve nābhimatasya bhāvepi siddhervi dhātābhāvāt
sādhayitumaniṣṭopyākāśaguṇatvādikāryatvenānityatvamātrasādhane dhvanau vivakṣite sati kāṇādāḥ keciccodayanti nyāyānabhijñāḥ
tatpradhāne ca hetupratijñayordoṣa iti taccāyujyamānaṃ śāstrāśrayepyastyapagatamātrasyaiva sādhyatvāt

evamapi yadi nāma dharmyabhāvena pakṣadharmasyāsambhavāt viruddhatvaṃ parihṛtaṃ
sarvvagata ā tmani sādhye sarvatropalabhyamāṇaguṇatvavadityasya samuccayārthaḥ
tathā hyasiddheḥ dharmisvabhāva ityatra pratipādakapramāṇāvṛtterasiddho dharmī vivakṣitaḥ syāt
pūrvasminpakṣe kaṇṭhenaivokto doṣa uttaratra śabdena samuccitaḥ
atha pratijñāmātrabhāvyeva hetvanapekṣaḥ pratijñāvirodho vyavasthā pyate yathā nāstyātmā śramaṇā garbhiṇītyatretyata āha
yadapīdaṃ hetuvirodhasyodāhara ṇaṃ dattaṃ nityaḥ śabda ityādinā tatpratijñāvirodhasya hetunāyuktamiti kathanāyāha
syāt matamubhayāśrayatvādvirodhasyaivamapi na hetuta evetyata ucyate ubhayāśrayepī 11b4 tyādi
yaccoktametena pratijñāyāḥ dṛṣṭāntavirodhādayopi vaktavyā bhaṇḍālekhyanyā yene 11b5 ti
iti śabdo vaktavya ityatra pratipattavyo'nyathāpareṇottarasyāprayuktattvāt duḥśliṣṭo bhaveta

yathā hi bhaṇḍā prākṛtān vismāpayantaścitralakṣaṇopetakapiśālabhañjikādipraticchandakamālikhya vicitraśilpakalākauśalasādino'tidi śaṃtyevaṃ prakārāṇyapyasmatkauśalanirmitānyekatālamātreṇa hastyādirūpakasthānāni pratipattavyānīti tathā jātīyakametadu dyotakarasya
tathā hyetadeva bhāva upa darśitahetuvirodhādikaṃ hetvābhāsavyatiriktalakṣaṇopetaṃ
yatra pratijñāyāḥ dṛṣṭāntavirodhastatrāpi pakṣīkṛtadharmaviparyayavati dṛṣṭānte sati virodhaḥ syāt pra tijñāyāḥ dṛṣṭānteneti śeṣaḥ
pakṣīkṛtaścā sau dharmaśca tasya viparyayaḥ sa vidyate yasminniti vigrahaḥ
yasmā dvaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyadharmaviparyayavāneva tatra ko virodhaḥ
viruddhe ca dṛṣṭānte sati yadi pakṣadharmasya vṛtti rananyasādhāraṇā prasādhyate pramāṇena viruddhastadā hetvābhāsaḥ
anyaśabdena pakṣīkṛtadharmaviparyayavataḥ pṛthagbhūtaḥ pakṣīkṛtadharmavānabhipretaḥ pakṣīkṛtadharmaviparyayavatyevavartate ityevaṃ yadi sādhyata ityarthaḥ
yathānayoreva sādhyadṛṣṭāntayoḥ kāryatvādi ti tadvipakṣīkṛtadharmabahirvyomādau na vartate tadviparīte punarghaṭe vartata iti
aprasādhite cātadvṛttiniyame tayoḥ sapakṣavipakṣayorvṛttiniyame sapakṣa eva varttate vi pakṣa eveti anaikāntika eva sandigdhānvayaḥ sandigdhavyatireko vā
yathā sarvvavidvītarāgo vā vivakṣitaḥ puruṣo na vā tathā vaktṛtvādrathyānaravaditi
paraḥ prāha viruddhadṛṣṭāntāvṛttau hetorviparyayavṛttau ca satyānna kaściddhetudoṣaḥ tadyathā'nityaḥ śabdaḥ pratyayabhedabheditvāt nabhovaditi sādharmyeṇa
dṛṣṭāntena tu virodhaḥ pratijñāyāḥ ityayaṃ hetudoṣānati krānto viṣayaḥ pratijñāyāḥ dṛṣṭāntena ca virodhasyeti
yasmād dṛṣṭānte na pratijñāyā virodhaḥ sā dharmye dṛṣṭānte doṣo na vaidharmye
yadi nā maivaṃ tathāpi kathaṃ hetvābhāsānativṛttirityāha sādharmyadṛṣṭānte ca viparītadharmavati nabhasi nā'vyabhicāradharmatā śakyā darśayitu~
yadāha trirūpo heturityuktaṃ pakṣadharme ca saṃsthitaḥ
rūḍhe rūpadvayaṃ śeṣaṃ dṛṣṭāntena pradarśyata 32 iti
nanu ca kathamaśakyā yāvatā pratyayabhedabheditvamanityatvāvyabhi cāryeva tatvata ityata āha
na hetudvāreṇa prāgdṛṣṭāntadoṣāt prasaṅgena parājitasya vādi no doṣāntarasya dṛṣṭāntavirodhasya vācyasya vānapekṣaṇāt parājitaparājayābhāvādityākūtaṃ
viśeṣeṇa sādhanāvayavānukramavādino naiyāyikasya sa hi pratijñāhetūdāharaṇopanayanigamanānāmānupūrvīṃ pratipannaḥ
aṅgīkṛtya cedamavādi na tu dṛṣṭāntavirodho hetvābhāsarūpāsaṃsparśyasti
evantāvadvyavasthitametadyathā pra tijñāyā dṛṣṭāntavirodho hetvābhāsānnātivartata iti
tatrāpi viruddho hetuḥ parimitattvasya hetoḥ sapakṣe'bhāve vā vṛtteḥ
saṃprati hetorapi dṛṣṭāntena virodho hetvābhāsāntargata iti kathayati
vaidharmye yadi syādapyatrodāharaṇamuktaṃ tenaiva guṇavyatiriktaṃ dravyamarthāntaratvenānupalabhyamānatvād ghaṭavaditi atrāpi dṛśyatve satīti hetuviśeṣaṇe viruddhaḥ sapakṣe avartamānatvāt
viśeṣaṇānupādāne tu vyabhicāro rthāntarattvenānupalabdhānāmapi pi śācādīnāṃ parasparavyatirekitvāt
na cātra ghaṭavaditi dṛṣṭānto yuktastasyaiva dravyāntaratvena pakṣīkṛtatvāt
tasya rūpādibhyo bhedena grahaṇaṃ pūrvvameva pratisiddhaṃ grahaṇe cāsiddho hetvābhāsa ityasmanmatameva sthitaṃ
atha hetoḥ pramāṇavirodhe ko hetvābhāsa ityāha
atha pratijñārthasya pratyakṣeṇa bādhitatvāddhetostena vyāptirnnāstīti hetoḥ pramāṇavirodha ucyate
evantarhi viruddhena sādhyadharmeṇāvyāpteḥ sandi gdhavyatireko hetvābhāsa ityasmatpakṣa eva samarthitaḥ
tasya tasyai katā nāsti yo yo bhāvaḥ parīkṣyate
na santi tenānekepi yenaikopi na vidyata 31
te sarve na viruddhena vyāptidharmeṇa yuñjata 34 iti
pratijñāyāḥ pramāṇavirodhaḥ svavacanavirodhena vyākhyātaḥ 12a2 kṛtapratikriyastatredameva nigrahādhikaraṇamasādhanāṅgabhūtāyāḥ pratijñāyāḥ sādhanavākye pra yoga ityādinā

ani tyaḥ śabda aindriyakatvād ghaṭavadityekaṃ bauddhenānyena vā kṛte mīmāṃsakaḥ kāṇādonyo vā svapakṣasiddhena gotvādinā sāmānye na parasya sādhanavādino bauddhasya hetorvyabhicārasiddhimākāṃkṣeta gotvamapyaindriyakaṃ tadapi bhavato'nityaṃ prasajyata ityeva yadi paraṃ pratye vādhyāropyābhidadhyād vyabhi cāraṃ tadā tasya bauddha sya tatsāmānyamaindriyakaṃ nityañca svapakṣaviruddhaṃ nityapadārthānabhyupagāmānnābhimatamataśca kathaṃ vyabhicāra iti virodho vyāhatirayuktattvamiti yāvat yujyata uttarasyetyadhyāhartavyaṃ

na tu punarevamasau parasyevopari bhāramupakṣipya vyabhicāramudbhāvayati tatkathamuttarasya virodhaḥ yataḥ sa hyuttaravādī svayaṃ pratipanne nityatvena gotve hetoraindriyakatvasya vṛtteḥ saṃśayānaḥ san kiṅghaṭavadaindriyakatvādanityaḥ śabdo bhavatu kimvā gotvā divannitya ityapratipattimaniścayamātmanastathā bruvāṇaḥ khyāpayati satpakṣe khalvendriyakamapi gotvaṃ nityaṃ tasmādayaṃ sāṃpratyanaikāntika itī tthamātmīyamevābhyupagamaṃ puraskṛtyānekāntañcodayati
syāt matambauddhasya nāstyevagotvaṃ nityaṃ tato vyāhatamevottara mityata āha
sa ca hetu 12a5 raindriyakatvāditi satyasati vā gotve paramārthataḥ
aprasādhitasādhanasāmarthyaḥ san viparyaye bādhakapramāṇāvṛtyā saṃśayahetutvāda naikāntika eva
aprasādhitaṃ sādhanāya sāmarthyaṃ sādhyā vinābhāvitvalakṣaṇamasyeti vigrahaḥ

yadā tu bādhakapramāṇabalena hetoravi nābhāvaṃ sarvvopasaṃhāreṇa sādhayati yatkiñcidindriyajñānagrāhyaṃ svanirbhāsajñānajanakatvāttatra sarvvamanityaṃ nityatve sarvvadā tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ prasañjate na vā kadācidapi tathāhi
tadānīṃ gotvādīnāmapi nityānāmekapraghaṭena iva pāṭitatvāt gotve hetoravṛtterna saṃśaya eva bhavati
tata eva tadanantaramāhānyaḥ punaḥ sādhyatvamīkṣata iti
yadapyukta mudyota kareṇa pratijñāvirodhasūtrameva vivṛṇvatā dṛṣṭāntābhāsā ityādi tadapyavayavāntaravādino naiyāyikasyāyuktaṃ
bauddha evaivaṃ bruvā ṇaḥ śobhata ityabhipretaṃ
tadvacanena hetvābhāsavacanena gamyamānasya dṛṣṭāntābhāsasya tasmāddhetoḥ sakāśāt sā dhanāntaratvā- bhāvaprasaṅgāt
nanu ca dṛṣṭāntābhāsānāṃ hetvābhāseṣvantarbhāve'tidiṣṭe hetordṛṣṭānte'vayavāntaraṃ na prāpnotīti vacana masambaddhamevetyata āha
yadyato'rthāntarabhūtaṃ na tadābhāsavacanena tadābhāsavacanaṃ nyāyyaṃ na ca tadābhāseṣu tadābhāsānāmantarbhāvaḥ
tathā ca bhavato hetordṛṣṭāntorthāntarabhūta iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ ato'vaśyaṃ dṛṣṭāntasya hetāvantarbhāva eṣṭavyaḥ
tatra ca na dṛṣṭāntaḥ pṛthak sādhanāvayavaḥ syāt
etadeva vyā caṣṭe yo dṛṣṭānta 12b1 ityādinā
evaṃ pratijñāhetvorvirodhasya prapañcasya hetvābhāsaiḥ saṅgṛhītatvānna pṛthagvacanaṃ karttavyamityabhidhāyādhunā pratighahā nyādīnāmapīyameva gatirityāvedanāyāha
kutaḥ asamarthasya nyāyabalena sādhyapratipādane vādina iti śeṣaḥ
uttaraḥ paścād phalabhāvī sa cāsau pratijñāsanyāsaśca tasyāpekṣayā kinna kiñcidityarthaḥ
aśaktaḥ paricchedaḥ saṃ khye yeṣāṃ klīvapralāpaceṣṭitānāṃ tāni tathā klīvādīnāṃ pralāpā yeṣāṃ vādinānteṣāṃ ceṣṭitāni pratijñāsaṃnyāsādīni vai kimupanyastaiḥ
tasmādetadapyasambaddhaṃ vidvatsadasyevaṃ prakārasya sthūlatvādittyābhiprāyaḥ tadatra bhāviviktaḥ svayamāśaṃkya kila pratividhatte sthūlatvenedaṃ nigrahasthānamiti cet
na brūmo dhvaṃsī śabda iti kintu saṃyogavibhāgābhyāṃ na vyakta ityayaṃ pratijñātārtha ityāha sāmānyasya ca svāśrayavyaṅgya tvāt vivādābhāva iti

anaikāntikadoṣeṇa pratiṣedhe hetau pratijñātārthāpahnavaṅkarotīti nigṛhyata iti tatravācyaṃ yadi vādī sākāṃkṣa evāntarāle kenacid durvvidagdhenānaikāntikadoṣeṇa coditaḥ sanpratijñātārthaphalīkaraṇena svābhiprāyamāviṣkaroti
atha nirākāṃkṣaḥ san paścāccoditaḥ pratijñāṃ viśinaṣṭi
tadapyanaikāntikadoṣeṇaiva nigṛhyata iti kimuttarapratijñāsaṃnyāsāpekṣayeti na kiñcitparihṛtaṃ kiñca sphuṭamidaṃ pratijñāntarentarbhavatīti naḥ pṛthagvācyamiti
aviśeṣokte hetāvi tyādi sūtraṃ atra nidarśanamudāharaṇamityarthaḥ
yā ca kila sā prakṛtirvikāragrāmasya tatpradhānamitīyamalīkapratyāsāsāṅkhyasyā parimāṇañcaturasramparimaṇḍalamityādi
nānāprakṛtīnāṅgavāśvādīnāmekaprakṛtīnāñca kumbhodañcanā dīnāndṛṣṭamparimāṇamityevaṃ pratyavasthite sati prativādini
ekaprakṛtisamanvaye sati parimāṇadarśanā diti saviśeṣaṇatvāddhetorvyabhicārābhāva iti matiḥ
sukhaduḥkha mohasamanvitaṃ hīdaṃ vyaktaṃ parimitaṃ gṛhya te
yathoktalakṣaṇa ityekādhikaraṇau viruddhau dharmāviti pakṣapratipakṣalakṣaṇaṃ smarayati
parigrahe vādiprativādibhyāṃ kṛte sati hetutaḥ sādhyasiddhau prakṛtāyāṃ hetuvasātsādhyasiddhirityetasminprakaraṇe sati prakṛtorthaḥ śabdanityatvaṃ
tathā hi vināpirūpasiddhyā prātipadikādivyākhyānaṃ yathā kathañcitpratipāditādarthādevārthaḥ sidhyati
pratipādite doṣe sati vādiprativādibhyāmanyonyamasādhanāṅgavacanametadadoṣadbhāvanañca bhavediti anyathā na hya na yorekasyāpi jayaparājayāvityuktaṃ
prakṛtamatra sādhyasādhanahetvabhidhānaṃ tadakṛtveti upanyaste doṣe na samarthanaṃ
8 yatra varṇā eva kevalaṃ krameṇa nirdiśyante
nahi varṇṇakramanirdeśādeva 13a9 kevalādānarthakyamapi tu yadeva kiñcidasādha nāṅgasyāsiddhaviruddhādeḥ śabdarūpasidhyādeśca vacanantadevānarthakaṃ
sādhyasiddhyupayogino'bhāve pi kasyānyatprayojanamastītyapi na mantavyaṃ iti kathayati
sādhyasiddhereva prastutatvādanyaprayojanavatvepi ānarthakyameva tatra prastā va ityabhiprāyaḥ
na sādhyasiddhau yadanarthakamanaṅgantannirarthakamabhipretamapi tu yasya vacanasya kākavāsitāderiva naiva kaścidarthaḥ
tathā ca nārthāntarāpārthakādīnāmanenaiva saṃgrahastatra kasyacidarthaleśasya sadbhāvāt
yasya kasya cida 13b3 pyādinopi nirarthakābhidhāne vāhita iva kinna nigraho bhavati
yasmānna ca varṇakramanirdeśopi nirarthakaḥ kvacitprakaraṇe pratyāhārādāvarthavatvācca
taccārthāntarāderapi tulyamiti cittaṃ kakkaṅpiṅgitamityatrādiśabdena utplutya gamanaṃ tāladānanṛttaādīnāṅgahaṇaṃ
sakṛduktaṃ spaṣṭārthamapi kadācinna jñāyata iti triruccāraṇaṅkāryaṃ
kasmātpunaḥ padavākyapramāṇavi d bhirvākyanna jñāyata ityāha
prāktane prakāre nāsyāsāmarthyantatra tu pariṣadādayo jāḍyā ttaduktanna pratipadyaṃta iti neyatā vidvānvādī nigrahamarhati
vādī tu jāḍyātpariṣadāderavijñātasādhanasāmarthya iti kṛtvā vijetā na syāt
udāharaṇaṃ daśa ḍāḍimāḥ ṣaḍapū pāḥ kuṇḍamajājinaṃ palalapiṇḍaṃ
atha raurukametat kumāryaḥ sphaiyakṛtasya pitā pratiśīna iti atra ca bhāradvājena nirarthakāpārthakayorabheda ityāśaṅkaya prativihitaṃ tatra hi varṇṇamātramiha yadānyasambaddhānīti
syātmatamapārthakaṃ naivāsambaddhapadārthāsambaddhavākyārthayoḥ saṅgṛhītatvāt pṛthag na vācyamityata ucyate
asambaddhapada vākyayostu sādhyasiddhyanupayogepi na sarvathā nairarthakyamato'rthatatve sāmyāt dvayorevaikīkaraṇamityata āha
nahi kiñcitmātreṇa viśeṣo na śakyate kvacitpradarśayitumityabhisandhiḥ atha nirarthakāpārthakayoḥ saṅgrahanirdeśadoṣaṃ bhedanirdeśe ca guṇampaśyatā' kṣapādena na saṅgrahanirdeśaḥ kṛta iti manyase
anupadarśite hi viṣaye nirviṣayā sādhanapravṛttirmā bhūditi sādhyanirdeśalakṣaṇā pratijñā pūrvvamucya te
tadanantara mudāharaṇasādharmyāṃtsādhyasādhanaṃ hetu rityevaṃ lakṣaṇo hetustatsādhanāyocyate
tataḥ pratibiṃbanārthaṃ sādhyadharmiṇi sambhavapradarśanārthamvāudāharaṇāpekṣastathetyupasaṃhāro na tatheti veti sādhanasyopanaya nyā0 sū0 1
tata uttarakālaṃ sarvvāvayavaparāmarṣeṇaviparītaprasaṅganivṛtyarthaṃ hetvapadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanaṃ niga manami nyā0 sū0 1
tathāhi lokepi pūrvvaṅkāryaṃ mṛtpiṇḍādyupādīyate paścāttu karaṇañcakradaṇḍādikamiti nyāyaḥ
naivamapi siddheriti bhāra dvājaḥ svayamevāśaṅkya pariharati
tathā kila goṇyādayaḥ śabdāḥ te sādhuṣvanumāṇena pratyayotpattihetava iti
tadetadunmattakasya vaiyā karaṇasyonmattakasaṃvarṇṇanamunmattakeno dyotakareṇa saṃvarṇṇanaṃ yathā hyeka unmatto dvitīyamunmattakaṃ samvarṇṇayati tathā bhūtametadapīti yā vat
yadi conmattakasyo dyotakara syonmattakasya vaiyākaraṇasya samvarṇṇanaṃ
tathā hi śābdika eva tāvadunmattaḥ pramāṇaviruddhavattvābhidhāyitvāt
yastu nakka śabdaṃ mukka śabdameva nāsāparyāyamvetti
sa kathamapaśabdācchabdaṃ sādhuṃ pratipadyātaḥ sādhoḥ śabdādarthampratipadyeta
kimucyate naivāsau tathā vivodhampratipa dyata ityāha
dṛṣṭācānubhayavedinopi 14b3 sanakā deḥ pratītiriti tasmānna paramparayā pratītirarthasya
yasmādetāvadanubhayavedinaḥ sanakā dayaste santamapi vyāpyavyāpakabhāvanna pratipadyante
tathāhyasādhūnāṃ sādhubhiḥ sambandhastādātmyaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo vā bhaveta
tatra ca tāvanna tādātmyamabhyupeyaṃ pāramārthikasyaiva bhedasya sphuṭaṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ
tatve vā sutarāntadutpatterabhāvaḥ satyapi vā vyāpyavyāpakabhāve tatparijñāne ca pakṣadharmatvavaika lyāccākṣuṣatvāderivāsādhubhyo nānumānaṃ
kimucyate puruṣo dharmī sādhuśabdavivakṣā sādhyadharmaḥ pakṣadharmaścāsādhuriti tadapyasambaddhaṃ
vayantu pratipadyāmahe sākṣādeva tasmādapyavyaktānmātrādyarthaḥ pratīyata iti
tathāhi na gavādiśabdānāmapi prā yaḥ śṛṅgaṅgrāhikayārthaniyamaḥ saṅketyatepi tu vyavahārapāramparyato vidagdhā niścinvanti
39 evaṃ sādhau prayoktavye yo yadbhraṃśaḥ prayujyate
tena sādhu vyavahitaḥ kaścida rthovasīyata 40 iti
evaṃ sādhau prayoktavye yo yadbhraṃśaḥ prayujyate
arthe pratipādanāyāsamarthasyāsādhoḥ śabdepi sādhau pratītija nanāsāmarthyācca
śabde cāsādhuḥ pratītijanaka eva na vācaka eva ityata āha
na hya rthepi śabdasya vācakatvamanyadeve 14b4- tyādi
naiva tarhyasāvarthapratītiṃ janayitu~ kṣamo'pi tu śabda eveti cedāha
athocyate śabdena tasya svābhāvikaḥ sambandho nārthena tatastame va pratipādayati nārthantadyathā svabhāvataścakṣūrūpaṃ prakāśayati na śabdādīnata āha
na hyapratītasambandhāḥ siṃhala śabdā ārya janavyavahārāya varttante
samayavasādasādhuḥ sādhau varttamānortha eva gavādau kinna pravartate
nahi kiñcittathā doṣo guṇastu kevala ityāha
ye svabhāvataḥ prakāśakā na te samayamapekṣante
